package.name: bonbon_fault_manager
package.description: Aggregates /bonbon/hal/fault (HalFault) and /bonbon/safety/state (SafetyState) into a classified, per-component fault registry (OK/WARNING/DEGRADED/FAULT/CRITICAL/BLOCKED) with concrete, component-specific recovery guidance -- built for the real BOM (ReSpeaker, OAK-D Lite, PAM8610, Cytron MDDS30, RPLiDAR, NEMA17 stepper, PCA9685 servo), not generic boilerplate. Publishes bonbon_msgs/ComponentFaultArray on /bonbon/fault_manager/registry for bonbon_operator_api's dashboard to consume. Does not duplicate bonbon_safety/watchdog_node's node-liveness monitoring -- this is a hardware-fault classifier, not a heartbeat watcher.
